metadata.description: Health Canada Cosmetic Ingredient Hotlist - Prohibited and Restricted Substances

substances.name: Safrole
substances.notes: Carcinogen

substances.name: Diethyl phthalate
substances.notes: Must not be used in toys or childcare articles

substances.name: 6-Methylcoumarin
substances.restriction: Not to be used in suntan products
substances.notes: Phototoxicity concerns

substances.name: Terpineol acetate
substances.notes: Peroxide value limits apply

substances.name: Peru Balsam
substances.notes: Sensitizer

substances.name: Oak moss absolute
substances.notes: Sensitization concerns

substances.name: Acetaldehyde
substances.notes: Carcinogen; IARC Group 2B

substances.name: Benzene
substances.notes: Known human carcinogen; IARC Group 1

substances.name: Chloroform
substances.notes: Carcinogen; hepatotoxin

substances.name: Methanol
substances.restriction: Permitted as denaturant for ethanol only
substances.notes: Toxic; permitted only as ethanol denaturant up to 5%

substances.name: Hydroquinone
substances.notes: Skin bleaching agent; restricted concentration

substances.name: p-Phenylenediamine
substances.restriction: Restricted to oxidative hair dye products only
substances.notes: Strong sensitizer; not permitted in products applied to skin

substances.name: Boric acid
substances.restriction: Max 5% as boric acid in non-oral products
substances.notes: Reproductive toxicant; not for use in products for children under 3

substances.name: Phenol
substances.notes: Caustic; limited to low concentrations

substances.name: Methyl Salicylate
substances.restriction: Not for use in products for children
substances.notes: Toxic in high doses; restricted in baby and children's products

substances.name: Camphor
substances.restriction: Max 3% in cosmetics; not for use in products for children under 2
substances.notes: Neurotoxic at high doses; restricted in children's products

substances.name: Menthol
substances.restriction: Not for use in products for children under 2
substances.notes: Can cause respiratory distress in infants

substances.name: Thymol
substances.notes: Irritant at high concentrations

substances.name: Toluene
substances.notes: Neurotoxin; reproductive toxicant

substances.name: Lilial (Butylphenyl Methylpropional)
substances.notes: EU banned since March 2022; Canada restricted use

substances.name: Atranol
substances.notes: Potent sensitizer found in oakmoss and treemoss

substances.name: Chloroatranol
substances.notes: Potent sensitizer found in oakmoss and treemoss

substances.name: Methyl eugenol
substances.restriction: Not to be added as an ingredient; tolerated in natural essential oils at restricted levels
substances.notes: Carcinogen; IARC Group 2B; naturally occurring in many essential oils

substances.name: Tagetes oil (Tagetes minuta / T. patula)
substances.notes: Phototoxic; contains alpha-terthienyl; must not exceed safe levels in leave-on products
